headline: Penn State and Clemson Meet at Crossroads in Week 10
subhead: Two ranked teams fighting to stay relevant in a pivotal late-season clash.

xFactor.why: Clemson's defense held Miami to 24 points last week and will need to contain Penn State's offensive rhythm after the Nittany Lions' 22-point home loss exposed vulnerability in execution.

keyMatchup: Penn State's offensive line must establish consistency against Clemson's front four, which showed improved gap discipline in the Miami win.
body: Penn State arrives in Clemson reeling from a 22-point home defeat to Boston College, a result that exposed both scheme and execution problems on the offensive side. The Nittany Lions have now dropped back-to-back games and sit at 4-5, needing to string wins together in a brutal stretch run. Clemson, by contrast, just shook off recent struggles with a convincing 11-point road win over Miami, where the defense created multiple opportunities and limited explosive plays.

Both teams know this is essentially a tournament game masquerading as Week 10. A loss here likely ends bowl eligibility for whichever team stumbles, and Clemson's recent momentum—particularly the defensive performance against Miami—gives the home crowd an edge. Penn State's path back requires an immediate reset and a reinvigorated offensive line, but Clemson's staff appears to have found their rhythm at the right time.
